text.en: The aorta is the main artery carrying blood from the heart to the body. In a dissection, a tear in its inner lining lets blood split the layers of its wall.

text.zh-CN: 这既可能堵住给脑、肾或腿供血的分支，也可能向外破裂造成大出血。因此突发症状需要急救评估。

supports.assessment: Acute symptoms and fatal bleeding/organ injury; emergency call advice.

text.zh-CN: A型累及从心脏向上走的升主动脉；B型不累及这一段，通常从胸部向下走的主动脉开始。分型直接影响是否立即手术。
text.en: Type A involves the ascending aorta leaving the heart. Type B does not involve that segment and usually starts in the descending chest aorta. The type directly affects the need for immediate surgery.

text.zh-CN: 主动脉瘤指血管异常鼓起，夹层指壁内分层，两者可以同时存在。胸痛是症状入口，不能仅凭疼痛位置确定是哪一种疾病。
text.en: An aneurysm is an abnormal bulge; a dissection is separation within the wall. They can coexist. Chest pain is a symptom, and its location alone cannot establish the cause.

supports.assessment: Defines aneurysm/dissection/rupture and need for assessment beyond pain.

text.zh-CN: 心肌梗死是心肌供血不足造成损伤，夹层是主动脉壁受损；夹层也可能影响冠状动脉供血。因此一次胸痛描述不能决定治疗。
text.en: Myocardial infarction is injury from inadequate blood supply to heart muscle; dissection is injury within the aortic wall. Dissection can itself impair coronary flow, so the pain description alone cannot determine treatment.

supports.assessment: Heart attack can result from dissection; imaging determines mechanism.

text.zh-CN: 主动脉瘤可能长期没有症状；瘤体破裂是血管壁被血液穿透。夹层、动脉瘤和破裂的定义不同，但都可能需要急诊血管评估。
text.en: An aortic aneurysm may remain symptomless for a long time. Rupture means blood escapes through the vessel wall. Dissection, aneurysm and rupture are distinct but can all require emergency vascular assessment.

supports.assessment: Bulge, internal separation and full-wall rupture are distinct.

text.zh-CN: 突然说话困难或一侧无力可表现得像脑卒中；若同时有突发胸背痛，医生还需考虑主动脉分支供血被夹层影响。
text.en: Sudden speech difficulty or one-sided weakness may resemble a stroke. When sudden chest or back pain accompanies it, clinicians also consider impaired blood flow from an aortic dissection.

supports.assessment: Neurological presentation and stroke complication.
Stroke-like presentation with dissection, not a lay diagnostic rule.

text.en: Diet supports blood-pressure and overall cardiovascular risk management; it cannot repair a dissection. Acute treatment is hospital-based.

supports.assessment: Hospital drug/repair approach, no dietary repair therapy.

text.zh-CN: 恢复期可把蔬菜、水果、全谷物及适量瘦肉或其他蛋白质作为日常饮食基础，减少高盐加工食品；减少盐有助于血压管理。
text.en: During recovery, build meals around vegetables, fruit, whole grains and appropriate lean protein, and reduce salty processed foods. Less sodium supports blood-pressure control.

supports.assessment: Food groups and sodium/BP relationship.

text.zh-CN: 不要为了“补血管”大量服用补品。现有夹层治疗资料的核心是修复、血压控制和影像随访，没有把某种食物列为修复血管撕裂的治疗。
text.en: Do not rely on supplements to “rebuild the artery.” The treatment sources focus on repair, blood-pressure control and imaging follow-up; they do not identify a food that heals the tear.

supports.assessment: Food/supplements are not the repair/BP/surveillance treatment pathway.

text.en: With coexisting chronic kidney disease, fluid, protein and salt plans depend on kidney function and nutritional status. Existing renal nutrition plans may need updating; fluid restriction is not a diet for everyone with dissection.

text.zh-CN: 有马凡等遗传综合征者可能较年轻就发病。专科会综合基因、家族史和主动脉影像，讨论本人及家人的监测，而非只按年龄判断风险。

text.en: People with known aortic disease should seek advice before pregnancy. US ACC/AHA2022 and European ESC2025 guidance both emphasize coordinated aortic and obstetric expertise for pre-pregnancy assessment and monitoring during pregnancy and after delivery. text.zh-CN: 预防重点是降低主动脉承受的压力并发现已知风险；这些措施不能把风险降为零。
text.en: Prevention focuses on reducing stress on the aorta and detecting known risks; these measures cannot remove all risk.

supports.assessment: Some risks modifiable, others inherited/age related.

text.zh-CN: 管理高血压、停止吸烟，并按已有心血管问题处理血脂和生活方式，是可以持续执行的措施。
text.en: Managing high blood pressure, stopping smoking and addressing lipids and lifestyle in the context of existing cardiovascular disease are continuing practical measures.

supports.assessment: BP, lipids/sugars, smoking and healthy lifestyle.
BP, smoking and cardiovascular risk management.

text.zh-CN: 有主动脉病或相关遗传病家族史时主动告诉医生，讨论影像或遗传咨询。家族筛查的目标是在发生急症前发现可以监测的异常。
text.en: Tell a clinician about a family history of aortic or related inherited disease and discuss imaging or genetic counseling. Family screening aims to detect abnormalities that can be monitored before an emergency occurs.

supports.assessment: Heritable risk and family screening.
Inform clinician about family/heritable disease and discuss evaluation.

text.zh-CN: 已经发生夹层者的预防重点是按计划服药、避免不适合自己的强力负重并完成影像复查。修复成功后仍需照顾整条主动脉。
text.en: After a dissection, prevention emphasizes prescribed medicines, avoiding unsuitable heavy exertion and completing imaging follow-up. The whole aorta needs attention even after a successful repair.

supports.assessment: Medicines, suitable exercise and CT/MRI surveillance.
Prescribed medicines and exertion precautions.
